title: 69b69t
description: Anarchy server who's gimmick is always running the latest Minecraft version.
body:
# 69b69t — The Most Up-to-Date Anarchy Server in Minecraft

**We run the latest stable Minecraft release. Always. No exceptions.**

Every time Mojang ships a new version, we upgrade. You will never log in to find us sitting on a version from six months ago. If you want to play the actual current game in an anarchy environment, this is the only server doing it.

---

## What this server is

- **Anarchy.** No rules, no moderation, no claims, no protection.
- **Permanent map.** The world never resets. What you build stays. What gets griefed stays griefed.
- **Always latest.** We track every stable Minecraft release. The world grows with the game.
- **Hacked clients welcome.** Fly, X-ray, killaura, speed — all of it. The game is the game.
- **Hard difficulty.** No hand-holding.

---

## What will get you banned

One category of things ends with a permanent IP ban: **attacking the server or crashing other players' clients.**

- Crash exploits (server process)
- Client crash exploits (book ban, chunk ban, sign crash)
- Lag machines
- Connection flooding / login bots
- Chat spam bots
- World corruption exploits

Everything else is fair game. These rules exist because the permanent map is the point. Destroy the map and you've destroyed the server for everyone.

---

---

*The map is permanent. The version is not. See you out there.*
